answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Proof of unique walking route via GPS trace flips the bet — a GPS trace of a real daily commute — and the plume lands on the attacker instead. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because a GPS trace of a real daily commute is bound to a single identity — the wharf is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the garden of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
